t: A free website for writing, running, and sharing p5.js sketches.
steps: Try a sketch without signing in.
Decide whether students will make accounts. Accounts are only needed to save sketches.
Check the accessibility preferences for screen reader output.
Ask IT to review the site and its analytics before students use it.
Consider self-hosting with the repository if the school wants more control.
Have students save their work by copying code into a file.
